verdict.rationale: Extend documents an official CLI at docs.extend.ai/cli. Its command set (parse, extract, classify, split, edit, detect-form, workflows run, batch) includes output and scripting support, and the Agent Quickstart explicitly covers equipping an agent that runs the CLI. A probe confirmed the CLI page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and documented detail beyond section headings (e.g., CLI installation and authentication specifics).
